items.title: Tamil Nadu Cyber Crime Wing busts illegal SIM box racket in Chennai; two arrested
items.body: Equipment and 182 SIM cards seized; setup linked to 301 cybercrime complaints across India, including 52 in Tamil Nadu

items.title: Chennai draft electoral roll records 29.14 lakh voters
items.body: Perambur has the highest number of electors at 2,28,139, followed by Velachery with 2,19,352 and Kolathur with 2,13,539. Harbour has the lowest electorate at 1,20,852

items.title: ‘Gem Granites’ Veeramani POCSO case: First charge sheet filed, Madras High Court told
items.body: Justice V. Lakshminarayanan told that the charge sheet was filed before a special court for POCSO cases in Chennai on November 11, 2026, and that the SIT intends to file multiple charge sheets in the next few days

items.title: Madras High Court suspends IAS officer Anshul Mishra’s one-month sentence in contempt plea
items.body: A Division Bench of Justices M.S. Ramesh and V. Lakshminarayanan direct the officer to deposit ₹25,000 with the Registrar (Judicial) of the High Court

items.title: Meet the Chennai chef blending European techniques with Indian flavours
items.body: After 13 years in London’s restaurant kitchens, Chennai-born chef Saikailash is back home, bringing together European techniques and Indian flavours through a series of supper clubs that celebrate his culinary journey

items.title: GCC plans ₹200-crore infrastructure upgrade for Guindy, Ambattur industrial estates
items.body: The proposed improvements will address deficiencies in basic infrastructure in the two industrial estates, which house several manufacturing units and information technology companies

items.title: VS Hospitals introduces digital mammography system for breast cancer detection
items.body: The system uses a 50-micron detector to capture detailed images of breast tissue, helping radiologists examine tiny microcalcifications that may be associated with early breast abnormalities

items.title: Man kills daughter’s friend in drunken altercation
items.body: The victim was a resident of Permabur

items.title: New integrated command centre to bring Metrowater’s monitoring units under one roof
items.body: The integrated facility would monitor operations of bulk water meters and household meters to fix leaks in water supply and track water quality parameters

items.body: The govt. clears 2,880 works to improve water supply, waterbodies, parks, and retaining walls in Chennai Corporation areas, other municipal corporations, municipalities, and town panchayats

St. John Ambulance to conduct home nursing aid course

items.body: The Minister says that the TVK government has not brought any books

items.title: Madras’ first weaver village
items.body: Colletpet near Tiruvottriyur, now known as Kaladipettai, was set up as a weaving village by Governor Joseph Collet in 1717

items.title: Tamil Nadu to push green cracker production in meeting with Sivakasi manufacturers this month: Minister V.K. Rajeev
items.body: On Chennai recording higher pollution levels this Deepavali, the Minister said the government would take up targeted awareness campaigns in Valasaravakkam, where the air quality levels were the highest in the city

items.title: Chennai Metro Rail seeks funds from Tamil Nadu govt. for MRTS maintenance for two years after takeover
items.body: The transition period of two years will begin once the Tamil Nadu government and Southern Railway sign the Memorandum of Understanding

items.title: Chennai Corporation to monitor air quality in city; installs sensors at 93 places
items.body: Digital boards have been put up to display real-time air quality index in 75 places; the Integrated Command and Control Centre is expected to play a central role in monitoring, analysing, coordinating, and managing air quality across the city

items.title: Heaps of biomedical waste dumped along Adyar river in Chennai’s Gerugambakkam
items.body: Under the Biomedical Waste Management Rules, 2016, biomedical waste must be segregated, collected, and disposed of through authorised treatment facilities

items.title: Children’s Day 2026: Meet the young sports stars putting Chennai on the map
items.body: Four young athletes pursuing national and international glory in swimming, chess, archery and football talk about their ambitions, gruelling training schedules, and what it is like to give up icecream

items.title: Madras Musical Association to host an evening of orchestral and choral music
items.body: When music is the host, who can reject an RSVP? Another musical evening is around the corner, as the group will showcase a symphony orchestra along with choral works
